tools.name: get_venue
tools.description:
A place by its slug: address, phone, website, opening hours and its whole menu -
food, drinks and this week's lunch - with every price.

tools.name: search_dishes
tools.description:
Find a dish or drink on the menus of places in Austria: which places serve it,
at what price, with diet and allergens. Give the dish in plain words ("schnitzel",
"vegan curry", "glutenfreie pizza"), and where: a point (lat, lon) to search near, a
map area (bbox), or neither for everywhere.

tools.name: search_lunch_menus
tools.description:
The lunch menus (Mittagsmenüs) served today - or another day of this week - with
every dish and its price, near a point or in a map area; with `q`, only the lunch dishes
matching it ("schnitzel", "suppe").

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description:
Places to eat and drink: by name, kind, cuisine, map area or nearness, open now, with
a menu, serving lunch today.
